scenarios.name: Select templates with the secondary mouse button

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project
the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders
the catalog root has no direct template files

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the English folder grouped by type using Medium icons
the Part group contains Standard (in) and Sheet Metal (in)
the user right-clicks the Standard (in) part template
Standard (in) is selected and its details show inch units
the user right-clicks the Sheet Metal (in) part template
Sheet Metal (in) is selected and its details show inch units
the user right-clicks empty space in the Part gallery
Sheet Metal (in) remains selected and its details remain displayed
the chooser closes and the original part remains active
